import zipfile, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
p='/home/user/Desktop/Employee Performance Evaluation Summary.xlsx'
ns={'a':'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main','r':'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships'}
with zipfile.ZipFile(p) as z:
    print('\\n'.join(z.namelist()[:20]))
    shared=[]
    if 'xl/sharedStrings.xml' in z.namelist():
        root=ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml'))
        for si in root.findall('a:si',ns):
            texts=[]
            for t in si.findall('.//a:t',ns): texts.append(t.text or '')
            shared.append(''.join(texts))
    wb=ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/workbook.xml'))
    sheet=wb.find('a:sheets/a:sheet',ns)
    rid=sheet.attrib['{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}id']
    rels=ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels'))
    target=None
    for rel in rels:
        if rel.attrib['Id']==rid: target=rel.attrib['Target']
    path='xl/'+target.lstrip('/')
    root=ET.fromstring(z.read(path))
    def cell_val(c):
        t=c.attrib.get('t')
        v=c.find('a:v',ns)
        if v is None: return ''
        val=v.text or ''
        if t=='s': return shared[int(val)]
        return val
    rows=[]
    for row in root.findall('.//a:sheetData/a:row',ns):
        vals=[]
        for c in row.findall('a:c',ns): vals.append((c.attrib.get('r'), cell_val(c)))
        rows.append(vals)
    for vals in rows[:10]: print(vals)
PY"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import zipfile, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
p='/home/user/Desktop/Employee Performance Evaluation Summary.xlsx'
ns={'a':'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main','r':'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships'}
with zipfile.ZipFile(p) as z:
    print('\\n'.join(z.namelist()[:20]))
    shared=[]
    if 'xl/sharedStrings.xml' in z.namelist():
        root=ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml'))
        for si in root.findall('a:si',ns):
            texts=[]
            for t in si.findall('.//a:t',ns): texts.append(t.text or '')
            shared.append(''.join(texts))
    wb=ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/workbook.xml'))
    sheet=wb.find('a:sheets/a:sheet',ns)
    rid=sheet.attrib['{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}id']
    rels=ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels'))
    target=None
    for rel in rels:
        if rel.attrib['Id']==rid: target=rel.attrib['Target']
    path='xl/'+target.lstrip('/')
    root=ET.fromstring(z.read(path))
    def cell_val(c):
        t=c.attrib.get('t')
        v=c.find('a:v',ns)
        if v is None: return ''
        val=v.text or ''
        if t=='s': return shared[int(val)]
        return val
    rows=[]
    for row in root.findall('.//a:sheetData/a:row',ns):
        vals=[]
        for c in row.findall('a:c',ns): vals.append((c.attrib.get('r'), cell_val(c)))
        rows.append(vals)
    for vals in rows[:10]: print(vals)
PY"
